region.name: Gulf of Honduras — Motagua River outflow (Guatemala / Honduras)

dataset_sources.note: real datasets resolved from data/ on this machine

notes: GEOGRAPHIC HOLDOUT NOT ESTABLISHED. Checkpoint detector_v1.pt withheld no tile of gulf_of_honduras (16PCC, 16PDC, 16PEC, 16QED), so these detections must be treated as potentially WITHIN-TILE and are not evidence of geographic generalisation. eval/results.md quantifies that gap.
Imagery covers AOI [-88.86, 15.88, -88.36, 16.28], not necessarily the full named region. Drift uses 12.0h RK4 integration steps; this is not merely trajectory output sampling.

Detections are restricted to open sea (ghostnet.sea_mask): SCL water connected to at least 25 km2 of water, and more than 300 m from the scene's no-data edge. Rivers, lagoons, ponds, land and swath edges are excluded. This is a per-scene approximation from Sentinel-2 classification, not a coastline dataset. The CNN sees real (not land-zeroed) reflectance, as in training; the FDI path zeroes land.

Exported 2026-11-07/08 from main ff99e90 plus the open-sea mask (76eddd5) and real, not land-zeroed, CNN input (915a452), branch claude/open-sea-mask. Replaces the earlier export, whose detections included land, inland water, swath-edge and shoreline positions.

GFW SAR inputs are hourly 0.01-degree grid observations with provider AIS matching, not exact SAR locations or independently matched raw AIS tracks. An observation can contain multiple detections; correlation strength operates on grid observations. Unmatched is an investigation signal, not evidence of illegal activity or proof of debris origin.
